name: CNN/DailyMail: Non-Anonymized Multi-Sentence Summarization Benchmark
description: CNN/DailyMail is a foundational abstractive and extractive document summarization benchmark originally constructed by Hermann et al. (NeurIPS 2015) and modified into its standard non-anonymized form by Abigail See et al. (ACL 2017). The dataset pairs full-length news stories from CNN and the Daily Mail with bulleted highlight summaries written by the story authors. In its standard version 3.0.0 split, the benchmark contains 287,113 training pairs, 13,368 validation pairs, and 11,490 test pairs (total: 311,971 documents).
